# Broad Street Boxing

> Amateur boxing club in Stratford-upon-Avon, Warwickshire (CV37 6HN). England Boxing affiliated. Est. 1987. Open to all ages and skill levels — complete beginners to competitive fighters.

## About

Broad Street Boxing was founded in 1987 and is a registered England Boxing amateur club. The club offers beginner, junior, fitness, and competitive boxing programmes. First session is always free. Head coach: Andy.

## Key Facts

- **Location**: Broad Street, Stratford-upon-Avon, CV37 6HN, Warwickshire, England
- **Phone**: 07700 900 456
- **Email**: coach@broadstreetboxing.co.uk
- **Website**: https://www.broadstreetboxing.co.uk/
- **Founded**: 1987
- **Affiliation**: England Boxing
- **Training hours**: Mon–Fri 5pm–9pm · Saturday 8am–1pm

## Classes

- **Beginner Fundamentals** — Mon, Wed, Fri 6:30pm. No experience needed. Stance, footwork, punches, defence.
- **Junior Boxing (Under 16s)** — Tue, Thu 5pm · Sat 10am. Ages 8–16. Safe, structured, England Boxing safeguarded.
- **Fitness & Conditioning** — Mon, Wed 7:45pm · Sat 9am. Boxing fitness without sparring.
- **Competitive Training** — Mon–Fri 7pm · Sat 11am. England Boxing licensed bouts, regional and national level.

## Membership

- Adults: £35/month (unlimited eligible sessions)
- Juniors: £25/month
- First session: always free
- England Boxing registration included in annual fee

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Do I need experience to join?**
No. Beginners are actively welcomed. The Beginner Fundamentals class is specifically designed for people with zero experience.

**What age can juniors start?**
From age 8 in the dedicated Under 16s programme, following England Boxing safeguarding guidelines.

**What equipment do I need for the first session?**
Just yourself, trainers, and a water bottle. Loaner gloves and wraps are available for beginners.

**How much does membership cost?**
£35/month adults, £25/month juniors. First session free.

**Are there competitive opportunities?**
Yes. England Boxing licensed bouts at local, regional, and national level. Competition is always optional.

**What should I wear?**
Comfortable gym clothes — shorts or joggers, t-shirt or vest. Flat-soled trainers preferred.
